companyContext.overview: ThoughtSeed is built on a simple belief: great products live at the intersection of code and creativity. The team crafts modern digital experiences that are fast, scalable, visually compelling, and focused on real-world impact.

experience.shortDescription: Building digital product experiences and production IoT systems processing 1M+ messages per day across 300,000+ devices, then layering AI automation for reliable real-world device control.
experience.narrativeDescription: At ThoughtSeed, a product studio focused on digital experience engineering, I work on IoT systems processing 1M+ messages per day across 300,000+ devices. On top of that scale, my current work centers on AI-driven smart home automation: Tuya-based device flows, hybrid intent parsing with LLM orchestration, and human-in-the-loop dry-run validation before automations affect real devices.
experience.ownershipSummary: Owned architecture and implementation across IoT flows, automation logic, validation, and integrations.
achievementBullets: Built IoT systems on the Tuya IoT Platform processing 1M+ messages per day across 300,000+ devices.
Architected a hybrid AI automation engine that routes high-frequency commands through regex intent parsing and complex multi-device workflows through LLM orchestration.
Implemented a human-in-the-loop dry-run validation framework, drastically reducing automation failure rates and ensuring reliable state transitions across IoT infrastructure.
Built a smart lock integration for Pongo Trasteros using Tuya-compliant locks to support secure digital access workflows.

experience.shortDescription: Independent full-stack engineering for client and product work, spanning web applications, internal tools, desktop apps, and backend systems.
experience.narrativeDescription: Alongside full-time roles, I have taken on freelance engineering work where I can own practical product outcomes end to end: frontend, backend, database, integrations, and deployment. This work is best positioned as the thread connecting my portfolio projects and contract availability.
achievementBullets: Built custom software across full-stack web applications, internal tools, and system architecture.
Shipped portfolio-grade projects including desktop and developer tooling with React, TypeScript, Go, Rust, and Tauri.

experience.shortDescription: Built marketing automation integrations, asynchronous reporting APIs, dashboards, and Web Push infrastructure for high-volume customer engagement.
experience.narrativeDescription: At Factoreal by Satisfi Labs, I worked on marketing automation systems behind customer engagement: messaging integrations, journey workflows, reporting APIs, dashboards, and push infrastructure. The work supported omnichannel campaigns across WhatsApp, SMS, Web Push, and reporting workflows, with sports and entertainment as an important domain context for fan engagement use cases.
experience.ownershipSummary: Held senior implementation ownership across integrations, APIs, reporting workflows, and dashboards.
achievementBullets: Integrated Factoreal with Satisfi Labs for WhatsApp and SMS channels, enabling faster channel rollout and broader omnichannel campaign reach.
Developed REST APIs with Hono, TypeScript, and Apache Kafka to support asynchronous reporting workflows and a React dashboard.
Built a Web Push service for 100,000+ users.
Implemented event filtering that reduced database resource utilization by 30%.

experience.shortDescription: Built charger connectivity services and data pipeline applications for EV infrastructure, including IoT migration work and internal platform tooling.
experience.narrativeDescription: At Ather Energy, I worked on charger connectivity and data pipeline systems close to the infrastructure layer: MQTT services, Kafka event pipelines, CDC flows, internal platform tools, and notification systems. I contributed to moving charger connectivity away from GCP IoT Core and AWS IoT Core toward Kafka and MQTT infrastructure, improving charger uptime stability across India and building systems used by internal teams and large user cohorts.
achievementBullets: Built data pipeline applications using Java, Go, and JavaScript for internal platform workflows.
Contributed to Rust and MQTT charger connectivity services while moving from GCP IoT Core and AWS IoT Core to Kafka and MQTT infrastructure.
Improved charger uptime stability across India by 20% through architectural changes to the charger connectivity platform.
Developed a notification engine for 100,000+ users.
Created Kafka Streams and Debezium CDC pipelines for analytics and database change propagation.
Built internal tools for controlled backend API access.

experience.shortDescription: Built PCB/manufacturing workflows across web, ordering, Gerber parsing, a Gerber viewer, file validation, CMS, and operations tooling.
experience.narrativeDescription: At Protoezy, I built PCB/manufacturing workflow software across the website, order flows, CMS tooling, Gerber parsing, a Gerber viewer, image processing, and Excel management. The work helped users validate board files before placing orders and gave me early full-stack ownership across UI, backend, database, and workflow automation in a manufacturing-oriented domain.
achievementBullets: Developed the Protoezy website using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Node.js, and MongoDB.
Built Gerber parsing, a Gerber viewer, manufacturing-ready file validation, image processing, Excel management, CMS, and an order workflow system using Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, SVGO, and Sharp.

My strongest work sits between product engineering and infrastructure, turning complex systems into interfaces and automations that people can trust.
